scoring_rule: Each of the 19 JA/NEIN items is one equal binary unit. computed_percent = round(verified_item_count / 19 * 100). NEIN receives no partial credit.

legacy_gap_reconstruction.explanation: The active checklist has 19 unweighted binary requirements. The evidence state behind the frozen 68 had 13 satisfied items and six named gaps: hosted candidate parity, immutable image publication/verifiability, candidate budget review, production auth closure, candidate observability path binding, and candidate open-question acceptance. 13/19 rounds to 68 and 6/19 rounds to the missing 32.

rulings_applied.E3: Phase 5 is release-candidate readiness. Local content-addressed verification satisfies I2; GHCR publication remains a post-market Owner gate and receives no separate percentage credit.
rulings_applied.retired_rc1_boundary: The six sslip.io/Hetzner RC1 markers are frozen historical records, not current checklist requirements and not open work.
